text: Every Echo station needs two things besides its input: Pulse, and a **Resonance Totem** of the right voice within **8 blocks**.
The totem is a teacher, not a generator. Without the right voice a station waits and spends nothing.

pages.title: Which voice does what
text: - **Earth**: Echo Shatter and the Stone Font.
- **Fire**: Echo Attune and the Ember Kiln.
- **Water**: Echo Bind.
- **Spirit**: Echo Manifest.
- **Air**: motion and song.
- **Loom**: Echo Unweave and Far Gates. It is the last voice; see [The sixth voice](sixth_voice).
Craft the totem you need and place it near the station. Crouch and right-click a paused station with this book: it names the voice it is missing.

steps.caption: Echo Shatter with stone inside, and a charged drum beside it.
A Fire totem is the wrong voice for Shatter. The station waits and spends nothing.
Swap it for an Earth totem and the work begins.

pages.title: Voices, not blocks
text: Stations count voices, not totems: two Earth totems are still one voice. Having many different voices matters to the Pulse Resonator and the Loom Anchor, which make more Pulse for every **distinct** voice around them.
Kinship Totems lend their tribe's element to nearby stations. On a Pulse Resonator they also add extra tribe voices, but never a seventh element.
A totem chalk-linked to one near the station lends its voice too, if it stands within 16 blocks of the station.
Each totem also holds **250 Pulse** for the lattice, and it has to be kept awake: see [Keeping](keeping).

pages.title: A generator for every voice
text: Each voice also has a generator of its own, the craft of the tribe that keeps it:
- **Earth**: the Drumheart.
- **Fire**: the Ember Horn, of the [Drumhearts](tribe_spark).
- **Air**: the Wind Harp, of the [Pattern-weavers](tribe_clock).
- **Water**: the Wave Drum, of the [Rootbinders](tribe_sprout).
- **Spirit**: the Wake Bell, of the [Seal-carvers](tribe_sigil).
- **Loom**: the Loom Anchor, of the [Loom-stitchers](tribe_spindle).
Get all six producing within **32 blocks** of each other and you earn **Six voices singing**.
